scope: Read-only mapping of requested classes to original existing regression PASS logs. No test reruns, GUI launches or production changes during this task. Original baseline results are unchanged.
interpretation: Established means only the explicit assertion at the stated evidence tier. Missing layers are NOT established and are never upgraded to a pass by test naming.

in_memory_orchestration.definition: Real orchestration/source/corpus modules with Map/Blob-backed workspace and injected extraction, provider and index adapters.

mocked_component_protocol.definition: Production component/FC handler with mocked cloud/network, bridge or context inputs; no live provider.

local_bytes_and_in_memory.definition: Production experiment parsing/query logic, real CSV/XLSX byte representation, in-memory workspace/registry; no real disk or live mapper.

local_policy_unit.definition: Direct deterministic function assertions with fixed query inputs.

real_filesystem.definition: Actual temporary disk directories, file bytes and symlinks through production ProjectFilesystem; no GUI.

real_qmd_sdk_filesystem.definition: Real QMD 2.8.3 SDK, project-local SQLite and Markdown mirror; lexical smoke only; no provider/GUI.

static_source_scan.definition: Source regex/policy assertions, not execution or network interception.

full_app_live.definition: Complete running application with real workspace and authenticated deployed FC/provider. NOT established by this matrix; parent live evaluation is independent.

rows.requestedClass: 150 unchanged papers and added papers touch only affected layers

notEstablished: Real 150-PDF cold extraction/provider latency or filesystem throughput; this fixture stores text in Blob objects named .pdf.
